purpose: Independent controlled mechanism variants; no changes to parameter/observation bounds

variants.name: v15_s3_v4root
variants.note: v4-R2 simultaneous root uptake kernel (from 4864 CG_Nitrogen NI_ROOT_KERNEL mode 2); psi-keyed feedback multiplies root_v; RootUptake.nml absent reproduces S1 byte-for-byte. root_v/root_k/diffusion_k are UNCALIBRATED engineering values (not in the PEST domain).

variants.name: v15_s4_nstate
variants.note: Fused plant-N state psi*: functional-N basis (v4 functional N + S2 signal N) on the unified dilution curve, two-sided anchored (-1 band floor via floor_ratio, +1 physical capacity via cap_density); deficiency side is the NNI_f deficit. Optional state_tau first-order relaxation of the published growth-side state (nb_get_psi) while the root-uptake feedback (nb_get_uptake_psi) stays instantaneous. 2x2 factor matrix root_kernel x nstate_mode in one binary; both nmls absent reproduces S1 byte-for-byte, RootUptake-only reproduces S3 byte-for-byte (dual-anchor regression verified). No new calibrated parameters.
